(Japanese: テラパゴスのかがやき The Sparkling of Terapagos) is the second arc of . It originally aired on TV Tokyo from October 27, 2023 to March 29, 2024. It is preceded by the Liko and Roy's Departure arc and followed by the Terastal Debut arc.

This chapter focuses on the mysterious Pokémon that emerges from Liko's pendant, and the search for Lucius's thought-to-be paradise Laqua. Liko and Roy learn about Lucius and the Six Heroes from Diana, setting them on a quest to find the remaining members of Lucius's team, better known as the Six Heroes. The arc also features escalating confrontations with the Explorers, who seek to capture the Black Rayquaza, and introduces Gibeon, the leader of the Explorers organization.

The arc's opening theme is Halo performed by × , and the ending theme is RVR ~Rising Volt Tacklers Rap~ by Liko (CV: Minori Suzuki) & Roy (CV: Yuka Terasaki).

(Japanese: テラパゴスのかがやき The Sparkling of Terapagos) is the second arc of . It originally aired on TV Tokyo from October 27, 2023 to March 29, 2024. It is preceded by the Liko and Roy's Departure arc and followed by the Terastal Debut arc.

This chapter focuses on the mysterious Pokémon that emerges from Liko's pendant, and the search for Lucius's thought-to-be paradise Laqua. Liko and Roy learn about Lucius and the Six Heroes from Diana, setting them on a quest to find the remaining members of Lucius's team, better known as the Six Heroes. The arc also features escalating confrontations with the Explorers, who seek to capture the Black Rayquaza, and introduces Gibeon, the leader of the Explorers organization.

The arc's opening theme is Halo performed by × , and the ending theme is RVR ~Rising Volt Tacklers Rap~ by Liko (CV: Minori Suzuki) & Roy (CV: Yuka Terasaki).
 

==Plot==
After Terapagos emerges from its pendant form, Liko receives Lucius's belt from her grandmother Diana, who shares the legend of Lucius and his journey to Laqua with the Six Heroes. The Rising Volt Tacklers embark on a quest to find the remaining members of Lucius's team, discovering a as the fourth member. During their journey, they encounter the Black Rayquaza multiple times, with Terapagos transforming into its for the first time during one of these encounters.

The Explorers intensify their efforts to capture the Black Rayquaza, with Amethio training under Hamber and receiving a Tera Orb. Diana departs from the group to continue her own journey. During this period, Dot a , and the group meets Franka, Dot's mother, who ultimately permits Dot to remain with the Rising Volt Tacklers.

The arc reaches its climax when the Explorers launch their operation to capture the Black Rayquaza. The Brave Olivine suffers major damage during the confrontation, and Amethio uses stallization for the first time while battling alongside the Rising Volt Tacklers against the Black Rayquaza. Despite their combined efforts, they are all defeated. Liko's evolves into during the battle. The arc concludes with Liko, Roy, and Dot deciding to learn more about the Terastal phenomenon, while Gibeon orders his admins to continue monitoring Liko and Terapagos. Gibeon is revealed to own a Zygarde.
